title: Hainanese-style chicken rice
skill: Rice by ratio, cooked in broth

notes.1: One saucepan serves 4. The rice and broth are measured for this size.

move.title: Rice that tastes like the chicken
move.body: Chicken rice is one of Singapore's favorite meals: tender chicken with rice cooked in chicken broth, ginger, and garlic. Today you'll cook the rice by a set ratio, then serve it with rotisserie chicken, cucumber, and two dipping sauces.

why.title: The ratio
why.body: Rinsed jasmine or long-grain rice takes 1½ cups of liquid for every cup of rice. Here the liquid is broth, so the rice tastes of chicken.

why.title: Rinse the rice
why.body: Rinsing washes off loose starch, so the grains come out separate instead of gluey.

why.title: Keep the lid on
why.body: The rice finishes in the steam under the lid. Lifting it lets the steam out.

why.title: Warm the chicken to 165°F
why.body: Cooked chicken that's been in the fridge needs to reach 165°F to be safe.

wrong.fix: It needed more time, or the lid came off. Cook 5 more minutes on low.
Sprinkle on 2 tablespoons of broth, lid on, 5 more minutes.

wrong.sign: The rice stuck to the bottom
wrong.fix: The heat was too high. Use the lowest setting.

quiz.q: How much broth for 1½ cups of rice?
quiz.explain: 1½ cups for each cup of rice.

quiz.q: Why cook the rice in broth?
quiz.explain: That's the heart of chicken rice.

steps.text: Rinse the rice in the colander under cold water. Swish it with your hand.
Heat the rice's oil in the saucepan over medium heat. Stir in the rice's ginger and garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the rice. Stir for 1 minute so every grain is shiny.
Pour in the broth and the rice's salt. Bring it to a boil.
Put the lid on. Turn the heat to low. Don't lift the lid.
Stir the soy sauce and sesame oil in the small bowl.
Slice the green onions thin. Stir them with the sauces' ginger, oil, and salt in a cup.
steps.look: Green and gold, and very fragrant.

steps.text: Slice the cucumber into thin rounds.
steps.tip: Use the claw grip, fingertips tucked in.

steps.text: When the rice timer rings, turn off the burner and leave the lid on.
Pull the chicken into strips, and put 2 cups on the plate.
steps.tip: Keep the rest in the fridge.

steps.text: Cover the plate and microwave the chicken until hot.
Push the thermometer into the thickest piece. It should read 165°F.
Fluff the rice. Serve it with the chicken, cucumber, and both sauces.
steps.look: Fluffy rice that smells of ginger.
